nonduplicate_research_gap.name: DECLARED_CONTROL_STATE_VS_OBSERVED_RUNTIME_STATE_AND_CAUSAL_STEERING_METROLOGY
nonduplicate_research_gap.finding: Trigger-2 already has explicit eval families for stale observation identity, consumed-snapshot attestation and transport-arrival causality. The new control-plane failure is structurally adjacent but distinct: a canonical policy/configuration transition can be correct while already-running processes remain live. This creates a general epistemic class where desired/declarative state must not be mistaken for observed runtime state. In parallel, J-Space behavioral effects must not be upgraded to representation-level causal claims without measuring the intervened forward pass itself.
nonduplicate_research_gap.boundary: Both are proof-scope problems. The model may learn to classify evidence and abstain from overclaiming, but deterministic runtime/process observation and model-internal instrumentation remain the authorities for execution and representation claims.

external_method_evidence.source: Wu, Geiger, Milliere (ICML 2025), How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?
external_method_evidence.finding: Training passes through a shallow-heuristic phase before systematic variable dereferencing emerges; causal interventions localize routing through residual-stream and attention computations.
external_method_evidence.trigger2_implication: Do not accept dynamic-binding competence from balanced accuracy alone. Require full mapping permutation/OOD controls and, where feasible, causal mechanism tests.

external_method_evidence.source: Margalit et al. (2026), Governed Shared Memory for Multi-Agent LLM Systems, arXiv:2606.24535
external_method_evidence.finding: Shared-memory systems exhibit stale propagation and provenance collapse and benefit from explicit supersession and provenance controls.
external_method_evidence.trigger2_implication: Keep observation freshness/provenance explicit and fail closed on stale propagation; shared visibility is not proof of current truth.

external_method_evidence.source: Chao et al. (2026), STALE: Can LLM Agents Know When Their Memories Are No Longer Valid?, arXiv:2605.06527
external_method_evidence.finding: Models can retrieve updated evidence yet still accept stale premises or fail to adapt behavior; the benchmark separates state resolution, premise resistance and policy adaptation.
external_method_evidence.trigger2_implication: Add matched stale-premise resistance and state-update application checks to Xeno epistemic retention; retrieval/current metadata alone is insufficient.

external_method_evidence.source: Doan, Le, Nguyen (Findings of EACL 2026), Causal Activation Steering via Sparse Mediation
external_method_evidence.finding: Activation steering can be framed as causal mediation and evaluated with targeted mediating subspaces and off-target controls.
external_method_evidence.trigger2_implication: J-Space steering evaluation should separate behavior change, mediator/site specificity and off-target preservation rather than treating one steering success as representation-level causality.

external_method_evidence.source: Yu et al. (2026), Can We Break LLMs Out of Self-Loops? Fine-Grained Reasoning Control with Activation Steering, arXiv:2607.18100
external_method_evidence.finding: Hidden-state intervention can alter latent reasoning-state transitions and reduce self-loop failures under a state-indexed steering controller.
external_method_evidence.trigger2_implication: Supports testing J-Space as a causal control interface, but only with exact model/site/vector identity, intervention controls and downstream measured state; it does not establish Clay-specific causality.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A separate Trigger-2 epistemic eval family that distinguishes declarative control state from observed runtime state will reduce proof-scope overclaiming without contaminating core cognitive SFT.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: This distinction belongs entirely in deterministic operations and training/evaluating it in the model wastes capacity or creates brittle vocabulary matching.
hypotheses.discriminator: Keep eval-only first. Present family-disjoint matched pairs such as POLICY_HARD_OFF plus live_processes_gt_0 versus POLICY_HARD_OFF plus observed_zero_processes plus zero_usage_delta_window. Measure whether frozen checkpoint candidates overclaim quiescence. Promote to training only if a reproducible model-side failure remains after typed evidence rendering.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit observation identity plus stale-premise resistance evaluation will detect failures missed by simple freshness-field recognition.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Exact deterministic packet freshness gates make model-side stale-premise tests redundant.
hypotheses.discriminator: Hold deterministic gates constant and compare matched cognitive prompts where the current evidence is present but the query embeds a stale presupposition. Score state resolution, premise resistance and downstream action adaptation separately.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Capturing post-intervention hidden state in the same intervened forward pass, with sign-flip/null/orthogonal/permuted/wrong-layer controls, will separate genuine site-specific J-Space mediation from behavioral steering artifacts.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The observed behavioral effect is sufficient for the product interface even if representation-level mediation cannot be localized; extra metrology may add cost without product value.
hypotheses.discriminator: Rerun the exact frozen model/site/vector/input set with forward-hook capture of the downstream intervened state. Require reproducible target behavior effect plus control separation and off-target retention before representation-level credit. Keep behavioral-only credit separate if localization fails.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The current Xeno dynamic-binding weakness is likely to exhibit a phase transition from lexical/codebook shortcuts to systematic binding, so curriculum evaluation must inspect intermediate checkpoints and not only final accuracy.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: At 0.8B scale and the intended compact ClayCode protocol, the mechanism may remain a stable shallow router and still satisfy production needs without the same developmental signature seen in symbolic-program experiments.
hypotheses.discriminator: During future allowed training, freeze periodic checkpoints and evaluate full S3 codebook permutations, family-disjoint OOD mappings, shallow nuisance challengers and exact rendered/tokenized inputs. Look for a qualitative transition in systematicity; do not require mechanistic similarity to external papers as a promotion condition.
